articles.title: As big bitcoin miners chase AI profits, individuals get another shot at the rewards
articles.snippet: Several companies offer access to bitcoin mining without the hassle of running equipment, but high costs and the 2028 reward halving make profits uncertain.

articles.title: 18 years in, what has Bitcoin truly done?
articles.snippet: The Bitcoin white paper achieved a lot of what Satoshi Nakamoto set out to accomplish, but the cultural impact it had may outweigh Bitcoin itself, writes CoinDesk's Nikhilesh De.

articles.title: A Nasdaq-listed company may sell $450 million bitcoin, citing Binance hack and quantum fears
articles.snippet: Next Technology Holding cited exchange security and quantum computing risks in authorizing sales or loans against its 5,833 BTC. It says none of the coins are held at Binance.

articles.title: Wall Street analysts urge investors to buy crypto stocks after $6.3 billion Binance hack
articles.snippet: Analysts at Cantor Fitzgerald, TD Cowen and Compass Point say the $6.3 billion Binance hack is unlikely to derail the crypto market's recovery.

articles.title: DeepSeek developing AI agent requiring less human input: Report
articles.snippet: The proposal comes amid intense competition among AI developers, including US companies Anthropic and OpenAI, the SCMP said.
